The formatter: -- in -- is formatted to -- want --, which formatting again keeps.

=== spacing and indentation
-- in --
import {A,B as C} from "script/x"
export class Bag implements Named{
size:number=0
private items:Map<string,number> =new Map<string,number>()
add(id:string,n:number):number{
if(n<=0){return -1}
const now=min(this.items.get(id)+n,99)
this.items.set(id,now)
for(let i=0;i<n;i++){this.size+=1}
return now>10?now:-now
}
}
-- want --
import { A, B as C } from "script/x"
export class Bag implements Named {
  size: number = 0
  private items: Map<string, number> = new Map<string, number>()
  add(id: string, n: number): number {
    if (n <= 0) { return -1 }
    const now = min(this.items.get(id) + n, 99)
    this.items.set(id, now)
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { this.size += 1 }
    return now > 10 ? now : -now
  }
}

=== comments and blank lines are kept, at most one blank line
-- in --
// A note
export function f( a : number ) : number {   // trailing
      /* block */


      return a   *2
}
-- want --
// A note
export function f(a: number): number { // trailing
  /* block */

  return a * 2
}

=== optional methods, unary operators and arrays
-- in --
interface I { hello ? ( ) : void ; name : string }
export function g(xs : number[] , ok : bool): number[] {
  if ( ! ok ) { return [ - 1 , xs [ 0 ] ] }
  return  xs . slice ( 1 )
}
-- want --
interface I { hello?(): void; name: string }
export function g(xs: number[], ok: bool): number[] {
  if (!ok) { return [-1, xs[0]] }
  return xs.slice(1)
}

=== continuation lines indent inside brackets
-- in --
export function f(): number {
return clamp(1,
2,
3)
}
-- want --
export function f(): number {
  return clamp(1,
    2,
    3)
}

=== source that doesn't lex is refused
-- in --
export const s = "unterminated
-- want --
error

=== unary operators never join into longer ones
-- in --
export function f(x: number): number {
  let y = - -x
  y = - - 1
  return + +y
}
-- want --
export function f(x: number): number {
  let y = - -x
  y = - -1
  return + +y
}
